messages:
maya: Kicking off preflight for the phased rollout. US -> EU -> APAC. Please don't start any unrelated deploys in the next 90m.
maya: Summary: version=v2.14.3, schema migration=none, feature-flag=underpin_cache=false. Rollout slices: US 30%, EU 30%, APAC 40% with warmup for APAC.
own: Confirmed. I've run the traffic smoke in staging. US perf looks fine.
anika: Quick capacity note: Dedicated US pool current headroom ~22% at baseline 1200 rps, EU ~8% at 830 rps, APAC ~15% at 650 rps (after warm pool). Recommend holding EU ramp to 20% instead of 30% unless we expand warm pool.
liam: +1 to holding EU. We hit GC storms there last week — want extra cushion.
jen: Ops will stand by for 2h window. I'll monitor error rates and queue depth.
deploy-bot: deploy started for slice=US percentage=10 target_version=v2.14.3
sre-bot: anomaly-watch enabled: latency spike alert threshold=1.8x baseline, error-rate delta=+0.5%.
own: US warmup smoke looks clean: p50 unchanged, p95 +30ms (expected). No OOMs. Rolling to 30% now.
manika: (typo) anika: EU holdpoint request: move EU from 30% -> 20% pending capacity increase.
maya: Agreed. Update deploybot pin for EU to 20% and mark APAC warmup + pin older-version fallback (v2.14.2) for APAC region.
deploy-bot: update: slice=EU set_percentage=20 pinned_fallback=none slice=APAC warmup=true pinned_fallback=v2.14.2
liam: If EU CPU > 75% or tail latency > 2.0x baseline we abort and roll back EU slice to v2.14.2.
jen: Rollback criteria noted. Also: if tokenization errors > 0.2% in any slice, immediate rollback.
own: Logging snippet from US smoke:
```
[2026-03-21T02:10:12Z] INFO warmup: model load ok
[2026-03-21T02:12:09Z] METRIC p95=420ms p50=60ms errors=0.01% cpu=58%
```

sre-bot: Observability hooks active: tracing enabled on route /v1/generate, sampler=10%. Linking alerts to #incidents.
manika: APAC warm pool started, pre-warm containers=6, expected headroom +18%. Will report in 10m.
maya: Operational play: if EU shows any sustained queueing > 30s, revert EU to pinned v2.14.2 and open rollback ticket.
own: Noted. I'm watching the deploy bot logs.
jen: I'll keep eyes on billing burst too — if the dedicated pool autoscaler spins up more nodes that could change latency.
liam: One more: confirm model quantization profile used is q4_0 across all slices? Last-minute mismatch caused perf variance earlier.
maya: Yes q4_0. Added to deploy notes.
deploy-bot: slice=US status=100% completed rollout version=v2.14.3
sre-bot: US metrics stable. p95 within threshold, errors nominal.
manika: EU at 20% steady for 12m, headroom improved to ~12% after small warm pool bump. Recommend continue to 25% hold.
own: Proceeding to 25% for EU.
deploy-bot: slice=EU status=25% target=30% note=hold-on-ops-recommendation
sre-bot: EU tail latency trending +12% but below abort threshold. Watching queue depth.
maya: Reminder: if we need to expedite rollback, use `/deploy rollback region=EU target_version=v2.14.2 reason=<short>` and tag @jen.
jen: I'll be ready. If we rollback, we'll also run a perf-gate to compare v2.14.2 -> v2.14.3 on a small canary.
liam: APAC warmup at T+22m: containers healthy, p95 slightly elevated but stable. Keep APAC pinned fallback ready.
manika: Final note: release notes posted to #release-notes with known issues and opt-out instructions for customers. Link: https://internal/release/3344556677
maya: Thanks all — leaving monitor window open for 60m. Call if anything spikes. :eyes:
